quote: On invalid strings (those with encoding errors), mb_substr() now interprets character indices in the same manner as most other mbstring functions.
reason: Whether a string has encoding errors is a run-time value; the runtimes show the new counting already on 8.3 (8.3.36), not first in 8.4 as the notes say, so the fixture claims changed_in 8.3.

quote: For SJIS-Mac (MacJapanese) strings, character indices passed to mb_substr() now refer to the indices of the Unicode codepoints which are produced when the string is converted to Unicode.
reason: A literal 'SJIS-mac' encoding is visible, but only strings holding one of the ~40 multi-codepoint characters are affected, which is a run-time value; the runtimes show the change already on 8.3 (8.3.36), so the fixture claims changed_in 8.3.

quote: The unused and undocumented constant MYSQLI_SET_CHARSET_DIR has been removed.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists MYSQLI_SET_CHARSET_DIR as removed in 8.4 (verified); InternalConstants reports it.

quote: The MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_PREFETCH_ROWS constant has been removed.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists MYSQLI_STMT_ATTR_PREFETCH_ROWS as removed in 8.4 (verified); InternalConstants reports it.

quote: The MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_FOR_UPDATE and MYSQLI_CURSOR_TYPE_SCROLLABLE constants have been removed.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists both constants as removed in 8.4 (verified); InternalConstants reports them.

quote: The unused MYSQLI_TYPE_INTERVAL constant, which is currently a stub and an alias for MYSQLI_TYPE_ENUM, has been removed.
reason: data/catalog/constants.php lists MYSQLI_TYPE_INTERVAL as removed in 8.4 (verified); InternalConstants reports it.

quote: The error code reported for MySQL server wait timeouts has been changed from 2006 to 4031 for MySQL server versions 8.0.24 and above.
reason: The code comes from a live MySQL 8.0.24+ server after a wait timeout, which no runtime here has; a comparison with the literal 2006 cannot be told apart from handling the 'server has gone away' error, which still uses 2006.

quote: The JIT config defaults changed from opcache.jit=tracing and opcache.jit_buffer_size=0 to opcache.jit=disable and opcache.jit_buffer_size=64M, respectively.
reason: INI defaults of the server configuration, not plugin or theme code.

quote: The maximum value of the opcache.interned_strings_buffer setting on 64bit architectures is now 32767 (it was previously 4095).
reason: INI setting of the server configuration.

quote: If JIT is enabled, PHP will now exit with a fatal error on startup in case of JIT startup initialization issues.
reason: Startup behaviour of the SAPI with JIT enabled, not visible in source code.

quote: The functions pcntl_sigprocmask(), pcntl_sigwaitinfo() and pcntl_sigtimedwait() now always return false on failure.
reason: The pcntl extension is in none of the runtimes (and is CLI-only), so nothing can be verified.

quote: The bundled pcre2lib has been updated to version 10.44.
reason: Literal patterns where {,n} or braces with spaces ({ 1,3 }, also seen on the runtimes though the notes do not say it) turn from text into a quantifier are reported; the changed UCP character classes depend on the subject and are not detected.

quote: setAttribute, DBLIB_ATTR_STRINGIFY_UNIQUEIDENTIFIER and DBLIB_ATTR_DATETIME_CONVERT have been changed to set value as a bool.
reason: The pdo_dblib extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: Since some Firebird C++ APIs are used now, this extension requires a C++ compiler to be built.
reason: Build requirement; the pdo_firebird extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: getAttribute, ATTR_AUTOCOMMIT has been changed to get the value as a bool.
reason: The pdo_firebird extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: getAttribute, ATTR_AUTOCOMMIT, ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES, MYSQL_ATTR_DIRECT_QUERY have been changed to get values as bool.
reason: pdo_mysql is loaded but getAttribute() needs a connected MySQL server, which no runtime here has; the call is visible, but only a strict comparison of its result with an int would change, and the receiver's driver is not known from the source.

quote: The DSN's credentials, when set, are given priority over their PDO constructor counterparts, being closer to the documentation states.
reason: The pdo_pgsql extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: Get methods called, or casting to a string on a SimpleXMLElement will no longer implicitly reset the iterator data, unless explicitly rewound.
reason: Which variable holds a SimpleXMLElement is not in the source, and the old behaviour was an endless loop, so code that relied on it did not ship; the fixtures show the loop ending from 8.4.

quote: SoapClient::$typemap is now an array rather than a resource.
reason: The property is private since 8.1 (the notes' example is_resource($client->typemap) throws an Error there), so it can only be reached through an array cast or reflection, which carry no visible property name; the fixture shows the change from 8.4.

quote: The SOAP extension gained an optional dependency on the session extension.
reason: Build and loading of extensions (--enable-rtld-now), not source code.

quote: strcspn() with empty $characters now returns the length of the string instead of incorrectly stopping at the first NUL character.
reason: A literal '' as $characters is visible in the call; a literal string without NUL bytes, which gives the same result everywhere, is not reported.

quote: http_build_query() now correctly handles backed enums.
reason: Whether a value in the array is an enum is a run-time value; the fixture shows name/value pairs up to 8.3 and the backing value from 8.4.

quote: stream_bucket_make_writeable() and stream_bucket_new() will now return a StreamBucket instance instead of an instance of stdClass.
reason: Reading ->data and the other properties works the same; only code that tests the class of the bucket notices, and that class is a run-time value.

quote: Failures in the constructor now throw exceptions rather than emitting warnings and having a broken object.
reason: The tidy extension is in none of the runtimes.

quote: The xml_set_*_handler() functions now declare and check for an effective signature of callable|string|null for the $handler parameters.
reason: Already covered by tranche 8.4-dep: Php84DepXmlHandlerMethodName reports method-name strings, and the runtime fixtures show the ValueError when handlers are set before xml_set_object() and the deprecated empty string.
